description: Search global sanctions, watchlists, and PEP (politically exposed persons) databases. Returns matched entities with names, countries, datasets, and sanctions details. Example: search_entities("Vladimir Putin") or search_entities("Huawei", schema="Company"). Requires your own OpenSanctions API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own OpenSanctions API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one; OpenSanctions is a commercial service). Get one at opensanctions.org/api — free for non-commercial use, paid for commercial. For a keyless US sanctions/export-control screen, use the sanctions-screening pack (sanctions_screen) instead.

query.description: Name or keyword to search (e.g., "Gazprom", "Kim Jong")

name: search_entities
